rejected.reason: Rejected walk: repeated leading-leg/contact poses instead of alternating gait, missing animal chest trophy, nominal crop edges clipped. Cannon-direction suspicion was retracted after close inspection and is not a rejection reason.

Rejected weapon identity: long axial staff with two crescent heads instead of supplied large curved arc and short perpendicular handle. Superseded by accepted corrected sheet.

limitations: No 1:1 fidelity certification; exact visual differences recorded per character.
No new walk, dash, landing, attack or full-library completion claimed.
Right and left are separate generated drawings, not transformed mirrored assets.
Apex physics state is brief; tucked drawing is also honestly reused at initial fall.
Fine digits are not individually certified; gross anatomy and weapon contact were visually reviewed.
Late-descent foot offsets and fallback costume scale require browser QA on the final build.

runtimeVerification.heldPoseRule: Single-frame crouch requires explicit heldPoseClips declaration, non-looping prepared one-drawing stance. Held apex/fall requires complete native-facing non-looping rise/apex/fall group, and a rising clip already proven to contain at least two distinct pixel drawings. No global relaxation for idle or walk.
